title: PR #102: ci: add org-wide standards revalidation
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Purpose
Revalidate existing repository code against the current ATC standards SSOT instead of assuming that older green CI remains compliant with newer standards.

## Exact-SHA model
- Standards SSOT is read from the repository registry and standards registry at the workflow execution SHA.
- Each target repository is cloned read-only and its exact checked-out HEAD SHA is recorded.
- The workflow asserts its own execution SHA before running.
- No target repository is modified.
- No merge, release, deploy, or branch-protection mutation is performed.

## Checks
The first implementation deterministically checks:
- repository exact SHA evidence
- presence of .atc/standards.yaml
- required standards from the central profile
- unknown standard IDs
- declared-version vs central-registry version drift
- core governance files

Manual/HYBRID REPO-AUDIT checks are explicitly reported as NOT_EVALUATED_BY_THIS_GATE and are never converted into PASS.

## Scope
This is a revalidation/evidence gate, not a remediation gate. Findings must be fixed through the normal SCR/UPD/change-control process.

Scheduled weekly and manually dispatchable.
